title: Here’s what happened in crypto today

title: Saylor’s Strategy buys $90M in Bitcoin as price trades below cost basis

title: OpenClaw AI hub faces wave of poisoned plugins, SlowMist warns

title: France arrests six suspects over crypto ransom kidnapping of magistrate

title: Wallet tied to Infini exploiter resurfaces to buy Ether dip for $13M
